using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Chroma;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

public class ChromaClientTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<ChromaClient>> _mockLogger;
    private readonly ChromaClient _client;

    public ChromaClientTests()
    {
        _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ChromaClient>>();
        var mockLoggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
        mockLoggerFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(typeof(ChromaClient))).Returns(_mockLogger.Object);
        _client = new ChromaClient("http://localhost:8000", mockLoggerFactory.Object);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GetEmbeddingsAsync_LogsDebugMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        string collectionId = "test-collection";
        string[] ids = { "id1" };

        // Act
        var task = _client.GetEmbeddingsAsync(collectionId, ids);

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            logger => logger.LogDebug(
                "Getting embeddings from collection with id: {0}",
                collectionId),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task GetEmbeddingsAsync_ExecutesWithValidParameters_LogsDebugMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        string collectionId = "test-collection";
        string[] ids = { "id1" };

        // Act
        await _client.GetEmbeddingsAsync(collectionId, ids);

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            logger => logger.LogDebug(
                "Getting embeddings from collection with id: {0}",
                collectionId),
            Times.Once);
    }
}
